subject: Polity & Governance
question_text: What is the quorum to constitute a meeting of either House of Parliament?
option_a: One-tenth of the total number of members
option_b: One-fifth of the total number of members
option_c: One-third of the total number of members
option_d: One-half of the total number of members
explanation: Article 100(3) of the Constitution stipulates that the quorum to constitute a meeting of either House of Parliament is one-tenth of the total number of members of the House.
